messages:
ida: Quick question: when a frontend mints an exchange token and includes X-Origin-Project, which project should the console show for quota? We're seeing inconsistent displays.
sam: Current short answer: we show token owner for SA tokens. That avoids trusting headers.
ida: But exchange tokens are signed by our exchange service now. Example: ```POST /v1/chat
Authorization: Bearer exch-xyz
X-Origin-Project: proj-shop
``` The console showed sa-owner.
devon: Router logic historically does: if token.type == service_account -> billing_project = token.owner_project else use token.project claim. We didn't add exchange claim checks initially.
joyce: UX ask: customers expect the displayed project to match who minted the request. Can we expose both values and explain precedence?
sam: Proposal: add `resolved_attribution` with source tags: exchange|header|token. Resolve order behind FF: verified exchange claim -> validated X-Origin-Project -> token owner.
ida: Sounds solid. Telemetry first: emit `auth.attribution.source` and `auth.attribution.mismatch` so we can see impact by org.
devon: I'll add audit log entries behind a FF and unit tests for tampered exchange claims. ops-bot: Created INFRA-4201 1: attribution resolver + telemetry + org toggle.
joyce: I'll design a tiny console tweak showing "Requested project" and "Billing project" with a tooltip referencing the org setting.
sam: Keep it opt-in default. Legal/sales want to review any default flips.
ida: OK thanks, devon please link PRs here when ready.
